name: Automation integrations
description: The types an automation integration is written against: nodes, choice lists and flow templates (`NodeContribution`, `NodeContext`, `ChoicesContribution`, `FlowTemplate` and what they reference). A module that adds to the automation engine keeps that code in its own folder and imports these types from here with `import type`, so it does not depend on the engine itself. Generated from the engine by scripts/gen-automation-contract.mjs; carries no code.
author: Kuray Karaaslan
